text:
62세 남자 환자, acute pulmonary edema로 입원함. 심한 mitral valve regurgitation 배경.

BP 110/70 mmHg, HR 98 bpm, RR 28 breaths/min, BT 36.8°C, SpO2 88% on room air.

Severe shortness of breath 호소함.

Furosemide 40 mg IV q8h 투여함.

Non-rebreather mask at 15 L/min 적용함.

Foley 유지함.

Positive fluid balance 200 mL over the last 24 hours 확인됨.

환자 alert 상태.
